root.def_en: The property or characteristic a metric measures or specifies, independent of the domain it belongs to.
root.def_zh: 指标所测量或规定的性质或特征，与其所属领域无关。

groups.name: geometry
groups.def_en: Size, shape and spatial extent of an object.
groups.def_zh: 对象的大小、形状和空间范围。

leaves.name: length
leaves.def_en: Length, width, height, thickness, diameter, circumference or distance.
leaves.def_zh: 长度、宽度、高度、厚度、直径、周长或距离。

leaves.name: area-volume
leaves.def_en: Surface area, cross-section, capacity in volume or internal volume.
leaves.def_zh: 表面积、截面积、容积或内部体积。

leaves.name: angle-form
leaves.def_en: Angles, tilt, straightness, flatness, roundness and other deviations of form or position.
leaves.def_zh: 角度、倾斜度、直线度、平面度、圆度等形状或位置偏差。

leaves.name: surface
leaves.def_en: Surface roughness, finish and appearance of a surface.
leaves.def_zh: 表面粗糙度、光洁度和外观。

leaves.name: thread-fit
leaves.def_en: Thread sizes, tolerances and fits, tapers and connector geometry.
leaves.def_zh: 螺纹规格、公差与配合、锥度和连接器几何。

groups.name: mechanics
groups.def_en: Mass, force, pressure, motion and mechanical behaviour.
groups.def_zh: 质量、力、压力、运动和力学行为。

leaves.name: mass
leaves.def_en: Mass or weight of an object or substance.
leaves.def_zh: 物体或物质的质量或重量。

leaves.name: force-load
leaves.def_en: Applied, measuring or bearing force, load and torque.
leaves.def_zh: 施加力、测量力、承载力、载荷和扭矩。

leaves.name: pressure
leaves.def_en: Pressure of a gas, liquid or contact, including gauge, vapour and differential pressure and pressure drop.
leaves.def_zh: 气体、液体或接触的压力，包括表压、蒸气压、压差和压降。

leaves.name: motion-vibration
leaves.def_en: Speed, acceleration, vibration, impact and shock.
leaves.def_zh: 速度、加速度、振动、碰撞和冲击。

leaves.name: strength-deformation
leaves.def_en: Strength, hardness, wear resistance, deformation, bending and friction.
leaves.def_zh: 强度、硬度、耐磨性、变形、弯曲和摩擦。

groups.name: thermal
groups.def_zh: 温度、热量和热力学性质。

leaves.name: temperature
leaves.def_en: Temperature of an object, substance, process or environment, including temperature differences.
leaves.def_zh: 物体、物质、过程或环境的温度，包括温差。

leaves.name: heat-transfer
leaves.def_en: Heat quantity, heat flow, heat exchange, heat loss and thermal capacity.
leaves.def_zh: 热量、热流、热交换、热损失和热容量。

leaves.name: thermodynamic-property
leaves.def_en: Properties tied to phase or state, such as boiling point, glide and saturation.
leaves.def_zh: 与相态有关的性质，如沸点、温度滑移和饱和状态。

groups.name: time
groups.def_en: Durations, intervals, rates of occurrence and dates.
groups.def_zh: 时长、间隔、发生频率和日期。

leaves.name: duration
leaves.def_en: How long something lasts or takes: operating, response, delay, observation or test time.
leaves.def_zh: 持续或耗费的时间：运行时间、响应时间、延迟、观察时间或试验时间。

leaves.name: interval-period
leaves.def_en: Time between repeated events, cycles and periods such as calibration intervals or reporting periods.
leaves.def_zh: 重复事件之间的时间、周期，如校准周期或报告期。

leaves.name: frequency
leaves.def_en: How often something happens per unit time, including signal frequency in hertz.
leaves.def_zh: 单位时间内发生的次数，包括以赫兹计的信号频率。

leaves.name: date-age
leaves.def_en: Calendar dates, target years, vintages, ages and age limits.
leaves.def_zh: 日历日期、目标年份、年份批次、年龄及年龄限制。

groups.name: electrical
groups.def_en: Voltage, current, power, impedance and electromagnetic behaviour.
groups.def_zh: 电压、电流、功率、阻抗和电磁特性。

leaves.name: voltage-current
leaves.def_en: Supply or signal voltage and current.
leaves.def_zh: 电源或信号的电压与电流。

leaves.name: electric-power
leaves.def_en: Electrical output or input power and electrical energy.
leaves.def_zh: 电输出或输入功率以及电能。

leaves.name: impedance
leaves.def_en: Resistance, impedance, capacitance and insulation resistance.
leaves.def_zh: 电阻、阻抗、电容和绝缘电阻。

leaves.name: emc
leaves.def_en: Immunity to and emission of electromagnetic disturbance, and recovery after interference.
leaves.def_zh: 对电磁干扰的抗扰度、电磁发射及干扰后的恢复。

leaves.name: light
leaves.def_en: Luminance, illuminance, luminous intensity, contrast and other photometric quantities.
leaves.def_zh: 亮度、照度、发光强度、对比度等光度量。

leaves.name: colour
leaves.def_en: Colour, chromaticity and colour difference.
leaves.def_zh: 颜色、色度和色差。

leaves.name: radiation
leaves.def_en: Ionizing or non-ionizing radiation, dose and wavelength.
leaves.def_zh: 电离或非电离辐射、剂量和波长。

leaves.name: sound
leaves.def_en: Sound pressure level, noise and acoustic power.
leaves.def_zh: 声压级、噪声和声功率。

groups.name: fluid
groups.def_en: Flow, tightness, filling, density and humidity of fluids.
groups.def_zh: 流体的流量、密封性、充装、密度和湿度。

leaves.name: flow
leaves.def_en: Volume or mass of fluid passing per unit time.
leaves.def_zh: 单位时间流过的流体体积或质量。

leaves.name: leakage
leaves.def_en: Leak rate, airtightness and sealing performance.
leaves.def_zh: 泄漏率、气密性和密封性能。

leaves.name: filling-level
leaves.def_en: Filling factor or coefficient, filling amount and liquid level.
leaves.def_zh: 充装系数、充装量和液位。

leaves.name: density
leaves.def_en: Mass per unit volume of a substance.
leaves.def_zh: 物质单位体积的质量。

leaves.name: humidity
leaves.def_en: Relative humidity of air and moisture content of materials.
leaves.def_zh: 空气相对湿度和材料含水量。

groups.name: composition
groups.def_en: What a substance consists of and its chemical properties.
groups.def_zh: 物质的组成及其化学性质。

leaves.name: concentration
leaves.def_en: Mass fraction, concentration, content or purity of a component.
leaves.def_zh: 组分的质量分数、浓度、含量或纯度。

leaves.name: chemical-property
leaves.def_en: pH, reactivity, toxicity, global warming potential and similar chemical properties of a substance.
leaves.def_zh: pH、反应性、毒性、全球变暖潜能值等物质化学性质。

leaves.name: particle
leaves.def_en: Size and size distribution of particles.
leaves.def_zh: 颗粒的大小及粒径分布。

groups.name: physiology
groups.def_en: Quantities about human or animal bodies, health and treatment.
groups.def_zh: 关于人或动物身体、健康与治疗的量。

leaves.name: vital-signs
leaves.def_en: Blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, body temperature and oxygen saturation.
leaves.def_zh: 血压、心率、呼吸频率、体温和血氧饱和度。

leaves.name: lab-values
leaves.def_en: Values measured from blood, urine or other specimens, such as glucose or cell counts.
leaves.def_zh: 从血液、尿液等标本测得的值，如血糖或细胞计数。

leaves.name: clinical-scores
leaves.def_en: Scores, grades, stages and thresholds used to assess a patient's condition.
leaves.def_zh: 用于评估患者状况的评分、分级、分期和阈值。

leaves.name: dose
leaves.def_en: Drug or treatment dose, concentration, infusion rate, route timing and repeat count.
leaves.def_zh: 药物或治疗的剂量、浓度、输注速率、给药时间和重复次数。

leaves.name: anthropometry
leaves.def_en: Body size, composition and physical fitness: height, arm circumference, body fat, grip strength.
leaves.def_zh: 身体尺寸、成分和体能：身高、臂围、体脂率、握力。

leaves.name: biological-activity
leaves.def_en: Responses of living organisms, such as germination index, growth or ecotoxicity.
leaves.def_zh: 生物体的反应，如发芽指数、生长或生态毒性。

groups.name: measurement-quality
groups.def_en: How well an instrument or method measures.
groups.def_zh: 仪器或方法的测量好坏。

leaves.name: accuracy-error
leaves.def_en: Indication error, maximum permissible error, hysteresis, zero error and accuracy class.
leaves.def_zh: 示值误差、最大允许误差、回程误差、零位误差和准确度等级。

leaves.name: resolution
leaves.def_en: Smallest distinguishable change, scale interval and digital step.
leaves.def_zh: 可分辨的最小变化、分度值和数字步进。

leaves.name: range
leaves.def_en: Range over which an instrument measures or displays, and rated ranges.
leaves.def_zh: 仪器测量或显示的范围以及额定范围。

leaves.name: precision-uncertainty
leaves.zh: 重复性、稳定性与不确定度
leaves.def_en: Repeatability, reproducibility, stability, standard deviation and measurement uncertainty.
leaves.def_zh: 重复性、复现性、稳定性、标准差和测量不确定度。

leaves.name: calibration
leaves.def_en: Calibration points, verification items, check points and conformity verification.
leaves.def_zh: 校准点、检定项目、检查点和符合性验证。

groups.name: performance
groups.def_en: How much and how fast a system or process delivers, and at what cost.
groups.def_zh: 系统或过程能提供多少、多快以及代价。

leaves.name: throughput-speed
leaves.def_en: Operations or items processed per unit time, latency and processing speed.
leaves.def_zh: 单位时间处理的操作或物品数量、时延和处理速度。

leaves.name: efficiency-energy
leaves.def_en: Efficiency, energy or resource consumption per unit of output.
leaves.def_zh: 效率、单位产出的能源或资源消耗。

leaves.name: capacity-size
leaves.def_en: How much a system holds or handles: treatment capacity, memory, buffer or cache size, number of users.
leaves.def_zh: 系统能容纳或处理的量：处理能力、内存、缓冲区或缓存大小、用户数。

leaves.name: success-ratio
leaves.zh: 命中率、成功率与失败率
leaves.def_en: Proportions of outcomes such as cache hit or miss rate, success or error rate.
leaves.def_zh: 结果的比例，如缓存命中或未命中率、成功率或错误率。

groups.name: reliability-safety
groups.def_en: How long and how safely something works.
groups.def_zh: 工作的持久程度和安全程度。

leaves.name: durability
leaves.def_en: Endurance, service life, retention period and ageing behaviour.
leaves.def_zh: 耐久性、使用寿命、保存期限和老化特性。

leaves.name: protection
leaves.def_en: IP codes and protection levels against water, dust, electric shock or fields.
leaves.def_zh: IP代码以及防水、防尘、防电击或防场的防护等级。

leaves.name: safety-limits
leaves.def_en: Limits that protect people or equipment, alarm conditions and priorities.
leaves.def_zh: 保护人员或设备的限值、报警条件和优先级。

groups.name: emissions
groups.def_en: Releases to the environment, their reduction and their accounting.
groups.def_zh: 向环境的排放、减排及其核算。

leaves.name: ghg-emissions
leaves.def_en: Amounts of greenhouse gases emitted, direct or indirect, by scope or source.
leaves.def_zh: 直接或间接、按范围或来源计的温室气体排放量。

leaves.name: reductions-removals
leaves.def_en: Reductions of emissions and removals or removal enhancements of greenhouse gases.
leaves.def_zh: 排放的减少以及温室气体的清除或清除增强。

leaves.name: carbon-credits
leaves.def_en: Carbon credits purchased, retired or used to offset emissions, and their vintage rules.
leaves.def_zh: 购买、注销或用于抵消排放的碳信用及其年份规则。

leaves.name: footprint-intensity
leaves.def_en: Carbon footprint, emissions per unit of output or activity, and emission factors.
leaves.def_zh: 碳足迹、单位产出或活动的排放量以及排放因子。

leaves.name: pollutants
leaves.def_en: Emissions or concentrations of pollutants other than greenhouse gases, such as VOCs, odour gases or dust.
leaves.def_zh: 温室气体以外污染物的排放或浓度，如VOCs、恶臭气体或粉尘。

groups.name: information
groups.def_en: Properties of data, records, identifiers and documents.
groups.def_zh: 数据、记录、标识和文件的属性。

leaves.name: data-format
leaves.def_en: Data type, representation format, length and allowed values of a data element.
leaves.def_zh: 数据元的数据类型、表示格式、长度和允许值。

leaves.name: cardinality
leaves.def_en: How many times a data element may or must occur.
leaves.def_zh: 数据元可以或必须出现的次数。

leaves.name: data-size
leaves.def_en: Sizes of keys, values, records, pointers and addresses, and address offsets.
leaves.def_zh: 键、值、记录、指针和地址的大小以及地址偏移。

leaves.name: identifiers
leaves.def_en: Codes, registry numbers, abbreviations and symbols that identify something.
leaves.def_zh: 用于标识的编码、登记号、缩写和符号。

leaves.name: document-metadata
leaves.def_en: Edition, page count, format, price and other attributes of a publication.
leaves.def_zh: 版次、页数、开本、定价等出版物属性。

groups.name: counts-ratios
groups.def_en: Numbers of things and dimensionless ratios not covered by a more specific facet.
groups.def_zh: 未被更具体维度涵盖的事物数量和无量纲比值。

leaves.name: sample-count
leaves.def_en: Number of samples, specimens, measurements, trials or repetitions.
leaves.def_zh: 样本、试样、测量、试验或重复的次数。

leaves.name: item-count
leaves.def_en: Number of components, keys, threads, phases or other items in a system.
leaves.def_zh: 系统中部件、按键、线程、阶段等项目的数量。

leaves.name: ratio
leaves.def_en: Dimensionless ratios, fractions and percentages between two quantities.
leaves.def_zh: 两个量之间的无量纲比值、分数和百分比。

groups.name: management
groups.def_en: Targets, baselines, boundaries and other management or reporting parameters.
groups.def_zh: 目标、基准、边界及其他管理或报告参数。

leaves.name: targets-baselines
leaves.def_en: Targets, ambition levels, baselines and thresholds for claims.
leaves.def_zh: 目标、雄心水平、基准和声明阈值。

leaves.name: boundaries
leaves.def_en: Reporting or system boundaries, cut-off limits, significance thresholds and categories included.
leaves.def_zh: 报告或系统边界、截止限值、重要性阈值和纳入的类别。

leaves.name: plans-resources
leaves.def_en: Plans, schedules, resources, review procedures and quantification methods.
leaves.def_zh: 计划、时间表、资源、评审程序和量化方法。

groups.name: features-markings
groups.def_en: Presence of functions, markings, labels and accompanying documents.
groups.def_zh: 功能的有无、标志、标签和随附文件。

leaves.name: functions
leaves.def_en: Whether a product has or provides a function or feature, such as data output or a rotatable display.
leaves.def_zh: 产品是否具有或提供某功能或特性，如数据输出或可旋转显示。

leaves.name: markings
leaves.def_en: Required markings, labels, warning symbols and their legibility.
leaves.def_zh: 规定的标志、标签、警示符号及其清晰度。

leaves.name: documents
leaves.def_en: Content of instructions for use, reports and other accompanying documents.
leaves.def_zh: 使用说明书、报告及其他随附文件的内容。
